main_text.p: [?]ɔ ، מִסְתּוֹר ، מִסְתָּר m. סִתְרָה f. Absconsio[?] atibulum, Latebra, Occultum, Abditum.
עָבִים עו[?] m.p. Trabes. Vide & infrà in עָבָה & עוֹב.

עָ Servivit: Servitute usus fuit, Servitutem imposuit; Coluit, Operatus est, Fecit, uomodo Chaldais usitatissimum. Niphal נֶעְבַּד Serviri, Coli. Pyhal עַבֵּד Serviri, Iiphil הָעֲבִיד Servire fecit vel coegit, Servitutem exegit, Servitute pressit.

Chald. Fecit: לָא עַבְדָה Non feci, Dan. 22. עַבְדוּ Fecerunt, Jer.10.11. Part. עָבֵד Faciens est, Dan.4.32.plur. עָבְדִין Faciunt, Esr.4.15: fœm. עַבְדָא קָרֵב Faciebat bellum, Dan.7.21. Infin. לְמֶעְבַּד Facere, Esra 4.22. uturum, דִּי תַּעְבִדוּן Quod facturi estis, Esr.6.8. Ithpehal Partic. מִתְעֲבַד בְּדִי Fit ea, Esr.4.19: fœm. מִתְעַבְדָא. Futurum, יִתעבד

page.notes: The left edge is cut away, so several line beginnings are fragments and are marked [?]. Hebrew and Greek-style vowel points are copied as far as legible; some Hebrew words are uncertain. The section letter ע is a bare letter, copied as a paragraph.
